pages.text: Immobilizes a fracture, pain $(cfg)2.5$() times lower.

A fracture can be closed or $(l)open$() (bleeds ~$(cfg)60$() ml/min). Heals $(cfg)4–5$() h online, ribs ~$(cfg)4.5$() h. A surgeon speeds it up with osteosynthesis.$(br2)$(l)Dislocation$(): pain and a weak limb. Reduce it with an empty hand in the $(l)H$() panel — very painful ($(cfg)70$()), give painkillers first. Sometimes the bone breaks ($(cfg)10%%$()).
